title: LeakageBench-MIDI: Measuring and Mitigating Same-Work Family Leakage in Symbolic Music Generation
description: A reproducible framework for measuring prevalence, controlled downstream evaluation inflation, structurally non-exact robustness, model susceptibility, reduced protocol-eligible external evidence, and family-aware mitigation for same-work family leakage in symbolic music generation evaluation. The deposit redistributes no original LMD or PDMX music data.
